# UPS fixtures

Synthetic responses shaped after UPS's OpenAPI spec for the Track and OAuth
APIs (github.com/UPS-API/api-documentation, read 2026-11-20). The carrier APIs
aren't reachable from cloud sessions, so these weren't recorded. Replace or add
to them with real, scrubbed responses from `scripts/live_check.py --save`.

`1Z999AA10123456784` is UPS's published sample number. Locations are
placeholders (`ANYTOWN, ST`) or public UPS hubs.
